newsitem.title: USA: Diamond Shamrock says underlying Q3 shr fell.
newsitem.headline: Diamond Shamrock says underlying Q3 shr fell.

text.p: Diamond Shamrock Inc said Monday that underlying earnings -- excluding the impact of general petroleum price movements -- were about $0.29 per share for the third quarter of 1996, compared with about $0.39 per share for the third quarter 1995.
Diamond Shamrock Monday reported third quarter 1996 earnings of $13.6 million, or $0.43 per share, compared to net income $5.7 million, or $0.16 per share, for the same quarter last year.
Diamond Shamrock's Chief Executive Officer, Roger Hemminghaus, said in a release that improved refining margins "contributed to stronger earnings for the quarter.
"Also, several recently completed capital projects as well as the Stop N Go stores acquired last December added to the quarter's results," Hemminghaus said.
